uncertainty: S2 Text 内全部可执行日期过滤器止于 2020-12-11（PubMed '2019/12/01:2020/12/11[Date - Publication]'；WoS 'Filter (year to date 2020/12/11)'；预印本 'FIRST_PDATE:[2019-12-01 TO 2020-12-11]'），而文章 Methods/摘要声明检索执行至 2021-04-30。S2 Text 疑似 2020-12-11 前后快照、未随 living 更新刷新到最终检索日；上表 query 字段照录 S2 Text 的可执行串，运行语料时需自行把日期段改为 2019-12-01 至 2021-04-30
WoS 索引试验串在 S2 Text 原文中为 TS=("antigen" OR "Lateral flow" OR "RDT" OR (("Point of Care*" OR "Bedside*" OR "Rapid*")AND Test*)) —— AND 前无空格、末尾双右括号，照原文转录，可能是文档排版伪影
PubMed 概念版检索串中 'Lateral flow' 使用弯引号（“Lateral flow”[tw]），执行版（[MeSH Terms]/[Text Word]）为直引号；已录执行版
Embase 与 Cochrane 未被本综述检索（Methods 仅列 PubMed、Web of Science、medRxiv、bioRxiv 与 FIND），任务预设数据库清单宽于实际
FIND 网站检索为人工浏览，无逐字检索串可复现（URL: https://www.finddx.org/sarscov2-eval-antigen/）
notes: 获取方式：文章页经 read_page(modsearch) 直读 Methods 'Search strategy' 段；补充材料从 PLOS 直链批量下载 s001–s017（正确格式为 article/file?type=supplementary&id=10.1371/journal.pmed.1003735.s00X，无 info:doi/ 前缀）。文件映射：s001–s010=S1–S10 Fig（PDF）；s011=S1 PRISMA Checklist（docx）；s012/s013/s014=S1/S2/S3 Table（xlsx，本次未读）；s015=S1 Text 研究方案（PROSPERO 提交稿，docx）；s016=S2 Text 检索策略（docx，检索串唯一来源）；s017=S3 Text QUADAS 解读指南（docx）。Zenodo 记录 4924035 仅含数据提取文件 'Covid Ag SR_MA Update V2.xlsx'，无检索串。检索概念：P=SARS-CoV-2，I=抗原快速检测（Ag-RDT），组合 P AND I。方法学要点：living review 每周检索（见 Author summary），结果发布在 https://www.diagnosticsglobalhealth.org ；无语言限制、含预印本。

methods_verbatim.search_strategy_section: We performed a search of the databases PubMed, Web of Science, medRxiv, and bioRxiv using search terms that were developed with an experienced medical librarian (M. Grilli) using combinations of subject headings (when applicable) and text-words for the concepts of the search question. The main search terms were "Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Corona-virus 2," "COVID-19," "Betacoronavirus," "Coronavirus," and "Point of Care Testing." The full list of search terms is available in S2 Text. We also searched the Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics (FIND) website ( https://www.finddx.org/sarscov2-eval-antigen/ ) for relevant studies manually. We performed the search up until 30 April 2021. No language restrictions were applied.
